composers_checked.name: Fesca, Friedrich Ernst
composers_checked.note: Floor from Apple Music track lists: cpo Complete String Quartets (Diogenes Quartett 2013 Vol. 1, Amaryllis Quartett 2020 Vol. 2) cover all 16 quartets and Potpourri No. 2; Linos Ensemble (cpo 2009) records Flute Quartets Nos. 1-3. Gap check against German Wikipedia's work list and IMSLP: only the Potpourri for violin and string trio, Op. 23 (A major, 1821) is missing from IMSLP, and no recording turned up. Quintets Opp. 8, 9, 15, 20, Flute Quintet Op. 22, Flute Quartet Op. 42 and Potpourris Opp. 6a, 29: no recording or performance found. Alexander Fesca (son) is in slice c48.

composers_checked.name: Clementi, Muzio
composers_checked.note: Floor from Apple Music track lists: Trio Fauré's four Dynamic discs (2000) record all of Opp. 21, 22, 27, 28, 29, 32, 35 and WoO 6; the Nonet is on one Genuin disc. Gap check against English Wikipedia's list (Tyson WoO numbers) and IMSLP: the duos (Op. 2, Op. 3 Nos. 4-6, Op. 5, Op. 15) are out; WoO 29 (Canon for Cherubini, two violins and viola, 1821) is a short canon with no recording found; Clementi's arrangements of Mozart and Haydn symphonies for piano, flute, violin and cello (Quartetto Clementi, Nar 1994) are arrangements of another composer's works: out. Nothing added.

composers_checked.name: Dittersdorf, Carl Ditters von
composers_checked.note: Floor from Apple Music track lists (Gewandhaus Quartet, Franz Schubert Quartet cpo, Kubin Quartet Multisonic; single quartets also by the Mannheim, Verdi and Bennewitz quartets). Gap check against English Wikipedia's work list, IMSLP, Apple Music and MusicBrainz: the other quintets (Kr. 185, 186, 188, 189), the Divertimento for two violins and cello in E-flat, the three trios for violin, viola and cello and the Quartet in E-flat have no IMSLP page and no recording found. Quintet No. 1 (Kr. 185) is listed on AllMusic and in IMSLP's comment as recorded by the Kubin Quartet (Multisonic, 1999), but I could not open its track list (key, timings), so it is not added: partial.

note: Fesca: the 16 quartets are numbered 1-16 in cpo's cycle and the Bitterhof edition; titles go by opus and number (house style), the running number is in aka. Op. 2 No. 3 is E major in German Wikipedia and Edition Silvertrust, E-flat major in cpo's track list and MusicBrainz (a MusicWeb review of the cpo set also says E-flat): the title leaves the key out (medium confidence). Op. 1 No. 2 is F-sharp minor in cpo, German Wikipedia and Bitterhof, while IMSLP's Richault list says A. A Hungaroton disc of the Op. 1 quartets by the Authentic Quartet (period instruments) turned up in a search result but could not be opened. Years: composition where a source gives it, else first print. Clementi: the 'piano trios' are accompanied keyboard sonatas. The Preston titles of Op. 32 and Op. 35 mark the accompaniments ad libitum (IMSLP); kept because the Trio Fauré record them with the instruments, and their notes say so. The flute-or-violin alternative is given where IMSLP or a title page prints it (Opp. 21, 22, 29, 32, WoO 6): IMSLP lists Op. 21 for flute only, but the Green edition is headed 'a flute or violin & violoncello' (Internet Archive); the Trio Fauré play all of them with a violin. Opus numbers vary between prints (Op. 27 is Op. 28 for Artaria and André, Op. 28 is André's Op. 29): the Trio Fauré numbering is followed, the other numbers are in aka. The Nonet is one movement of 8:27 on the Persius disc ('completed by P. Spada') but 15 minutes on IMSLP's Seely edition; I could not open a source on the completion, so it is kept as a short, medium confidence. Dittersdorf: the six quintets are for two violins, viola and two cellos (IMSLP, Edition Silvertrust and the Swiss Literary Archives agree); English Wikipedia's list says 'vcl., ctbs.', which I did not follow. IMSLP's Kr. 187 page prints 'Br.187' in its catalogue field. The two concertos for two violins in outOfScope (with strings or orchestra) were left out as listed. Quintet No. 1 (Kr. 185, Kubin Quartet) is the open item: recorded but unverified, not added.
